technique_name: Explain the differences between an operating system and a program.
description: An operating system is the main software that manages and controls a computer system, while a program is a set of instructions that tells a computer how to perform a specific task. An operating system is responsible for managing the hardware and software resources of a computer, as well as providing a platform for application programs to run on.
